key_insight: A spray distance of 190 mm produced the densest Cr3C2–NiCr coating and the best corrosion resistance on DSS 2205 in 1 M H2SO4.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing D-gun spray distance is a practical way to improve coating integrity and extend the life of stainless steel components in acidic industrial service.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm distances.
Characterized coating morphology by SEM and porosity.
Evaluated corrosion behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
evidence_signal: Porosity dropped from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, and the 190 mm coating showed the lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy) versus 2.60 mmpy for the uncoated substrate.
watch_item: The optimum distance was identified under one acidic electrolyte and room-temperature test conditions, so performance may differ in other environments or service temperatures.
paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
